findings.text: A passing-score document with an open hold at the rotation cap becomes exhausted, while clear_holds_not_raised and dismiss_hold only promote docs_stage='reviewed' (review/holds.py:161). Clearing or dismissing its last hold therefore leaves the document exhausted even though its judged score passes and no hold remains; the link-gate comment at graph_ops.py:17854 explicitly says not to exhaust a document over a link finding. The graph test covers only docs_chain_length=0, so add the cap case and preserve a stage from which dismissal can accept it.

The worker raises and clears ReviewHold nodes before persist_reviewed_docs checks claim_token and claim_seq at graph_ops.py:17942-17948. If a concurrent reviewer wins or the claim is stale, persistence returns a no-op but this worker has already changed the winner's holds; it can place an open veto on an accepted document or clear the winner's veto. Bind hold writes to the verified claim and stage in the same transaction as review persistence, with a stale-claim test.

Promotion after a clear or dismissal changes docs_stage to accepted but leaves edit_status open or exhausted; persist_reviewed_docs updates that companion status when it accepts at graph_ops.py:17922-17931. A held edit dismissed later can therefore remain advertised as unfinished after acceptance; update the paired lifecycle state and add an assertion to the dismissal test.
